# Validation diagnostics

demo_data: false

Exploratory/transductive: shared preparation fits target values, density reference, pitch identity and arsenal statistics globally. Model fits are train-only but these reports do not establish inductive out-of-sample performance. Physics ablations are predictive diagnostics, not causal effects or production promotion evidence.

RMSE skill is a fraction (0.01 = 1%). CIs resample held-out pitchers. Calibration uses mean predicted/observed rv_x, not probabilities. Park identities are inferred franchises, not verified stadium labels.

Official data with production settings. Sample stability uses global full-season features; it does not establish a deployment minimum pitch count.
